display.name: CPU 使用率（%）
display.description: 主机 CPU 忙碌比例，按节点分线。负载、I/O 等待与磁盘网络见「主机资源」。

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace((monitoring_chart_value{environment="a3-vllm",schema="host-cpu-v1",path=~"nodes\\.(prefill|decode)\\.cpu",node=~".*",node=~".*"} and (monitoring_chart_valid{environment="a3-vllm",schema="host-cpu-v1",path=~"nodes\\.(prefill|decode)\\.cpu",node=~".*",node=~".*"} == 1) and (min_over_time(monitoring_chart_valid{environment="a3-vllm",schema="host-cpu-v1",path=~"nodes\\.(prefill|decode)\\.cpu",node=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(monitoring_chart_valid{environment="a3-vllm",schema="host-cpu-v1",path=~"nodes\\.(prefill|decode)\\.cpu",node=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(monitoring_chart_value{environment="a3-vllm",schema="host-cpu-v1",path=~"nodes\\.(prefill|decode)\\.cpu",node=~".*",node=~".*"}) >= 0) and (time() - timestamp(monitoring_chart_value{environment="a3-vllm",schema="host-cpu-v1",path=~"nodes\\.(prefill|decode)\\.cpu",node=~".*",node=~".*"}) < 15)), "role", "Prefill", "node", "a3-1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "a3-2")

display.name: 主机内存（GiB）
display.description: 主机已用内存与总量，按节点分线。

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace(((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*",node=~".*"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*",node=~".*"}) / 1024^3) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*"}) < 15)), "role", "Prefill", "node", "a3-1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "a3-2")

label_replace(label_replace((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*",node=~".*"} / 1024^3) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="a3-vllm",job="node-a3",node=~".*"}) < 15)), "role", "Prefill", "node", "a3-1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "a3-2")

display.name: 异常采集目标数（个）
display.description: 本环境当前抓取失败的采集目标数；0 为正常，没有任何新鲜采集时留空。具体目标见「采集与监控健康」。

spec.query: count((up{environment="a3-vllm"} and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="a3-vllm"}) < 15)) == 0) or (count(up{environment="a3-vllm"} and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="a3-vllm"}) < 15)) * 0)
